@@U01534@@
Dear God, the thoughts a man like that must think! He puts me to shame. All I can do is stand there and say yes. What a poor stupid girl I am. I can’t imagine what he sees in me.

@@U01535@@
(Exit.)

@@U01538@@
(Alone.)

@@U01539@@
Exalted spirit, you gave me all, all I prayed for, everything. It wasn’t for nothing you turned your gaze on me from the flame. You gave me glorious Nature for my kingdom, the power to feel and enjoy her; not merely cold and wondering visits, but the privilege to gaze deeply into her being as into the heart of a friend. You parade before me endless lines of living creatures, and teach me to know my brothers in the silent thicket, in air, in water. And when the stormwind roars and rages through the forest, and the giant fir tumbles and crashes, crushing neighboring limbs and trunks, and its fall echoes like thunder through the mountains, then, oh, then you lead me to this sheltered cavern and reveal to me the secret depths and wonders of my heart. And when, as now, the pale moon rises and gently limns the landscape, I see rising before me silvery shapes slipping from rocky cliffs and marshy thickets tempering the austere joy of contemplation.
translation:
@@U01534@@
亲爱的上帝，这样的人一定有这样的想法！他让我感到羞愧。我所能做的就是站在那里说“是”。我是一个多么可怜又愚蠢的女孩啊。我无法想象他在我身上看到了什么。

@@U01535@@
（退出。）

@@U01538@@
（独自一人。）

@@U01539@@
崇高的精神，你给了我一切，我所祈求的一切，一切。你把目光从火焰上移到我身上并不是无缘无故的。你为我的王国赋予了我光荣的自然，以及感受和享受她的力量；不仅是冷漠而好奇的拜访，而且是有幸深深地凝视她的存在，就像凝视朋友的内心一样。你在我面前展示了无数的生物，并教我认识我在寂静的丛林中、空气中、水中的兄弟。当暴风雨呼啸而过，肆虐森林，巨大的冷杉翻滚、崩溃，压碎邻近的枝干，它的倒下像雷鸣般回响在山间，那么，哦，那么你就带我来到这个受庇护的洞穴，向我揭示我内心的秘密深度和奇迹。当苍白的月亮升起，温柔地照亮大地时，就像现在一样，我看到银色的形状在我面前升起，从岩石悬崖和沼泽灌木丛中滑落，缓和了沉思的严峻乐趣。
